description: List the snapshots Scrivener has saved of a project's documents (from the .scriv package's Snapshots/ directory). Pass documentId to list one document's snapshots, or omit it to list snapshots for every document that has any. Each entry gives the owning document id and title, a snapshotId (pass it to read_snapshot to get the text), the snapshot's title, and its date. Read-only. Returns an empty list when nothing has been snapshotted. Requires an open project (call open_project first).

documentId.description: UUID of a single document to list snapshots for. Omit to list all documents.

name: list_snapshots

documents.description: One entry per document that has snapshots.

documentTitle.description: Document title, if the document is still in the binder.

title: List Document Snapshots
